verdict.rationale: Notion's own docs show that Custom Agents exist as a product feature: tokens can find them, track their usage, and manage their status and credit limits, and they can be shared with connections. This confirms user-owned agents, but the evidence does not document the in-product building and configuration experience. Missing for 10: documentation of creating an agent in the product, configuring its instructions, tools, triggers or schedules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build and configure my own custom AI agent within the product

citations.quote: Find the Custom Agents your token can access, track their usage, and manage their status and credit limits.
The connection can access only Custom Agents that are explicitly shared with it.
